'''Tantos''' was a feared [[Firrerreo/Legends|Firrerreo]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] lord—brutal and dangerous— whom many considered to be a barbarian. His arms were covered with three-dimensional tattoos of strange beasts. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] he bought the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girl [[Pala Kwi'teksa]] from [[Madame Vansitt's Charm Academy]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to use her as his personal [[assassin]] and [[spy]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref> He was officially the child's third master.
